request: Deploy the game to the tablet
outcome: Installed and launched verified frozen workspace snapshot on the authorized OnePlus Pad 2

visual_verification.initial: tablet-launch.png shows Over and under loading screen
visual_verification.final: tablet-final.png shows a running five-lap Grass race, lap 2, Compact car and native touch HUD

commands: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/dev.ps1 -Action ExportAndroid -QuickValidation -CommandTimeoutSeconds 900 (two initial root exports; neither installed because concurrent shipping sources changed)

Freeze game/native/scripts/godot-version.txt/.gitignore into build/tablet-deployment-2026-10-23/source using Git cached and nonignored files; retain source-manifest.json; copy immutable imported cache files and the hash-verified matching Android source template
Set GIT_DIR to the original repository .git and GIT_WORK_TREE to the frozen source; run its scripts/dev.ps1 -Action ExportAndroid -QuickValidation -CommandTimeoutSeconds 900
Recompute frozen Write-ClientBuildIdentity; require exact match; aapt dump badging; Get-FileHash SHA256
From frozen source: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/dev.ps1 -Action InstallAndroid -DeviceSerial f0ba474a -CommandTimeoutSeconds 300
From frozen source: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/dev.ps1 -Action LaunchAndroid -DeviceSerial f0ba474a -CommandTimeoutSeconds 120
ADB device properties/package metadata/pm path/sha256sum/pidof/process-filtered logcat; normal wake and keyguard dismissal; screencap/pull
retained_history: Initial sandbox Doctor failed to create /.android. Authorized toolchain access found the OnePlus tablet, initially authorizing and then device/online.
Two initial root exports passed focused validation but shipping sources changed during export. Neither APK was installed; frozen source build resolves the race with ongoing edits.
One inline source-check attempt encountered Windows PowerShell execution policy; process-only Bypass matched the existing build wrapper.

First frozen export stopped because its ignored .tools/admob/android_source.zip was absent. Copied the original verified template (SHA256 A15416B528EFB0A19A7D187E4D9F4E5336D0689144B111329FB4BD12C4447AD3), then reran successfully.

Focused desktop startup retains a Thread cleanup warning, catalog retains an anchor warning, and the driving harness reports a desktop RACE_HITCH. Assertions passed; this is not device performance certification.
remaining_acceptance: Sustained device frame pacing and thermals
Edits made after the frozen deployment snapshot require a subsequent build
